endorsements.name: Chris Roberts
endorsements.label: When “Whose line is it anyway?” met InfoSec…
endorsements.description: We’re going to break this into two sections, firstly, and after exhaustively crawling through the entire marketing propaganda from 7,000 vendors in our industry we’re going to bring you the best of gibberish 101. That vendor promising to maximize your ROI on that EDR/SIEM/SoggySOC through advanced quantum machine algorithms that are crypto-chained secure by elves in Iceland? Yep, they’ll be in there, along with a heap of other examples that our panel has to not only work out WHO said it, but also what the heck it means in plain, simple English. (We’re still working out if we’re using colonial English OR proper English). The second section is the panel must give a 30-60 second improv on how THEY’D implore you to buy whatever the hell widget that we’ve just assassinated… YOU get to “vote” Roman style with a thumbs up or down based on how well they described the quantum entangled antivirus on steroids, and IF you both understood and/or think it’s valuable… Good luck, and may the force be with ALL of us
